intro.title: Introduction
intro.paragraph1: Food Sources Trading Co is a family-owned enterprise that has been in operation for over 8 years. Established in 2015, they specialize in supplying fresh and nutritious food in Deli to key accounts, restaurants, catering companies, and grocery stores around SA.
intro.paragraph2: The company prides itself on providing quality products that not only meet customer needs but also adhere to the highest standards of safety and hygiene. From sourcing, only the freshest ingredients to ensuring secure and safe packaging, Food Sources Trading Co is committed to delivering top-notch customer service.
intro.paragraph3: Food Sources Trading Co is a leader in the global food industry, and its products are trusted by customers all over the world. They are committed to providing the highest quality food ingredients while also being mindful of the environment and making a positive contribution to society.

ordering.q1: What is the minimum order quantity?
ordering.a1: Our minimum order quantity varies by product. Generally, we require a minimum order of 2 units per product. For bulk orders, we offer attractive discounts.
ordering.q2: How do I place an order?
ordering.a2: You can place orders through our customer portal, by requesting a quote on our website, via email at orders@foodsources.com.sa, or by calling our sales team at +966 XX XXX XXXX.
ordering.q3: Can I modify my order after placing it?
ordering.a3: Orders can be modified within 2 hours of placement. Please contact our customer service team immediately if you need to make changes.
ordering.a4: Yes, we offer tiered pricing based on order volume. Contact our sales team for a customized quote based on your specific needs.

delivery.q1: Which areas do you deliver to?
delivery.a1: We deliver across Saudi Arabia, with next-day delivery available in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. Other cities receive delivery within 2-3 business days.
delivery.a2: Standard delivery is 1-3 business days depending on your location. Express delivery options are available for urgent orders.
delivery.q3: How do I track my order?
delivery.a3: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email and SMS. You can also track orders through your customer portal.
delivery.q4: What if my order arrives damaged?
delivery.a4: We take quality seriously. If your order arrives damaged, please contact us within 24 hours with photos. We'll arrange a replacement or refund immediately.

products.a1: Yes, all our products are SFDA certified and meet international food safety standards. Many items also carry Halal certification.
products.q2: How should I store the products?
products.a2: Storage instructions vary by product. Generally, keep items in a cool, dry place. Specific storage guidelines are provided on each product label and spec sheet.
products.q3: Can you source products not in your catalog?
products.a3: Absolutely! We have an extensive network of Mediterranean suppliers. Contact our product team with your requirements, and we'll work to source it for you.
products.q4: What is the shelf life of your products?
products.a4: Shelf life varies by product category. Olives and pickles typically have 18-24 months, while cheeses vary from 6-12 months. Check product specifications for details.

payments.q1: What payment methods do you accept?
payments.a1: We accept bank transfers, credit cards, and for approved accounts, we offer Net 30 payment terms.
payments.a2: Yes, qualified businesses can apply for credit accounts with Net 30 or Net 60 payment terms. Contact our accounts team to apply.
payments.q3: How do I access my invoices?
payments.a3: All invoices are available in your customer portal under the 'Invoices' section. You can also request copies via email.
payments.a4: We offer full refunds for damaged or defective products within 7 days of delivery. Quality issues are handled on a case-by-case basis.

account.q1: How do I create an account?
account.a1: Request a quote on our website, and our team will set up your account. Once approved, you'll receive portal access credentials.
account.q2: I forgot my password, what should I do?
account.a2: Click 'Forgot Password' on the portal login page. You'll receive a reset link via email.
account.q3: Can I have multiple users on my account?
account.a3: Yes, business accounts can have multiple users with different permission levels. Contact support to add users.
account.q4: How do I update my account information?
account.a4: Log into your portal and navigate to Settings > Account Information to update your details.

general.a1: We're open Sunday to Thursday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed on Fridays and Saturdays.
general.a2: We operate distribution centers in Riyadh and Jeddah. We're primarily a B2B supplier and don't have retail stores.
general.q3: How can I become a supplier?
general.a3: We're always looking for quality suppliers. Send your company profile and product information to suppliers@foodsources.com.sa.
general.a4: No, we're a food distribution company. We supply ingredients to hotels, restaurants, and caterers.
